_comment: Scoped to this project only. Justin asked three times to stop being
prompted; 'auto' and then 'dontAsk' both still let commands through to a
confirmation path, so this is the full-off switch.
The deny list is kept. If bypassPermissions ignores it, the protection that
actually matters is simpler and not a setting: cisa/results/ is real study
history, it is the one thing here that cannot be recreated, and it does not
get touched. Everything else in this repo is in git.
There may be a single confirmation dialog the first time this takes effect.
That one is left for you deliberately - one deliberate yes is the right
place for consent, and it is not mine to click.
To undo: set defaultMode to 'default' to be asked about everything, or
